svg.title: Robustness to measurement drift
svg.desc: Worst-case win margins over the classical optimum as the maximum additional offset of Bob's middle measurement increases. Squares and the dashed line represent the frozen game. Circles and the solid line represent the redesigned game.

rect.style: stroke: none; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-width: 1; fill: rgb(100%,100%,100%); fill-rule: evenodd;

text.style: font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 28px;fill: rgb(9%,18%,22%); stroke:none;
font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 15px;fill: rgb(27%,35%,40%); stroke:none;

g.text: Both games face the same offsets and detector-loss scenarios.
